title: EFC — Flow, Entropy, and Spacetime Distortion in Cosmological Clusters
abstract: Analyzes three SDSS DR18 galaxy clusters to study how energy flow diminishes with redshift while entropy increases, incorporating spacetime distortion and gravitational lensing corrections. Reports a best-fit power-law index n = −0.33 for energy-flow evolution, a small negative spacetime-distortion parameter α = −0.059, and a lensing factor of 0.636, with cluster entropies remaining homogeneous. The study argues these trends are consistent with stable halo dynamics across clusters.
